name: MCP Secure Local Server
description: A security-focused Model Context Protocol server that enables controlled local tool execution through strict network firewalls, filesystem protections, and rate-limiting policies. It features a plugin-based architecture for progressive tool discovery and includes reference implementations for web searching and bug tracking.
